items.source: Constructor with URL patterns which are prepended with "/" if necessary.
items.translation: 带有 URL 模式的构造函数，必要时会在前面添加"/"。

items.source: patterns - 0 or more URL patterns; no patterns results in an empty path "" mapping which matches all requests.
items.translation: patterns - 零个或多个 URL 模式；无模式会导致空路径 `""` 映射，该映射匹配所有请求。

items.source: In contrast to PathPatternsRequestCondition which uses parsed PathPatterns, this condition does String pattern matching via AntPathMatcher.
items.translation: 与使用解析后的PathPattern的PathPatternsRequestCondition不同，此条件通过AntPathMatcher进行字符串模式匹配。

items.source: A matching pattern is obtained by making checks in the following order:
items.translation: 匹配模式通过按以下顺序进行检查获得：

items.source:
Combine the patterns of the current and of the other instances as follows:
  • If only one instance has patterns, use those.
  • If both have patterns, combine patterns from "this" instance with patterns from the other instance via PathMatcher.combine(String, String).
  • If neither has patterns, use "" and "/" as root path patterns.
items.translation:
按以下方式合并当前实例和其他实例的模式：
  • 如果只有一个实例具有模式，则使用这些模式。
  • 如果两者都具有模式，则通过 PathMatcher.combine(String, String) 将“this"实例的模式与其他实例的模式合并。
  • 如果两者都没有模式，则使用 "" 和 "/" 作为根路径模式。

items.source: Checks if any of the patterns match the given request and returns an instance that is guaranteed to contain matching patterns, sorted via PathMatcher.getPatternComparator(String).
items.translation: 检查是否有任何模式匹配给定的请求，并返回一个保证包含匹配模式的实例，该实例通过 PathMatcher.getPatternComparator(String) 排序。

items.source: Find the patterns matching the given lookup path. Invoking this method should yield results equivalent to those of calling getMatchingCondition(HttpServletRequest). This method is provided as an alternative to be used if no request is available (for example, introspection, tooling, etc).
items.translation: 查找与给定查找路径匹配的模式。调用此方法应产生与调用 getMatchingCondition(HttpServletRequest) 等效的结果。如果不可用请求（例如，内省、工具等），则提供此方法作为替代方案。

items.source: Return the mapping paths that are not patterns.
items.translation: 返回非模式的映射路径。

items.source: Pattern match with ".*" appended if the pattern doesn't already contain a "."
items.translation: 如果模式本身不包含"."，则附加"。*"进行模式匹配。

items.source: Pattern match with "/" appended if the pattern doesn't already end in "/"
items.translation: 如果模式不以"/"结尾，则附加"/"进行模式匹配。

items.source: a collection of matching patterns sorted with the closest match at the top
items.translation: 一组按最接近匹配项排在顶部的匹配模式集合。

items.source: For example " || " for URL patterns or " && " for param expressions.
items.translation: 例如，URL 模式使用 `" || "`，参数表达式使用 `" && "`。

items.source: It is assumed that both instances have been obtained via getMatchingCondition(HttpServletRequest) to ensure they contain only patterns that match the request and are sorted with the best matches on top.
items.translation: 假定这两个实例均通过 `getMatchingCondition(HttpServletRequest)` 获取，以确保它们仅包含匹配该请求的模式，且最佳匹配项排在最前。

items.source: For example URL patterns, HTTP request methods, param expressions, etc.
items.translation: 例如 URL 模式、HTTP 请求方法、参数表达式等。
